biotools.summary: The outpatient Global Point Prevalence Survey (Global-PPS) is a freely available, web-based tool for measuring antimicrobial use in outpatient care worldwide. It aims to provide a standardized approach and facilitate data reporting, supporting antimicrobial resistance surveillance efforts.
